definitions.gloss: after-party; second party; continuation of a gathering at a different venue
definitions.explanation: a gathering that takes place after the main event, typically at a different location such as a bar or karaoke

examples.japanese: {二次会|にじかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カラオケ→カラオケ：05080_karaoke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Let's go to karaoke for the after-party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{二次会|にじかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: After the drinking party, we went to an after-party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二次会|にじかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれた→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
{二次|にじ} (secondary) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (gathering) → second gathering

THE NUMBERED PARTY SYSTEM:
Japanese social gatherings often progress through multiple venues:
- {一次会|いちじかい} (first party) - main event, often formal dinner
- {二次会|にじかい} (second party) - more casual, often bar or izakaya
- {三次会|さんじかい} (third party) - even more casual, often karaoke
- {四次会|よじかい} (fourth party) - late night, smaller group

COMMON {二次会|にじかい} VENUES:
- ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧ (Japanese pub)
- ⟦バー→バー：07060_baa⟧ (bar)
- ⟦カラオケ→カラオケ：05080_karaoke⟧ (karaoke)
- ダーツバー (darts bar)

WEDDING {二次会|にじかい}:
Wedding after-parties are often more casual and fun than the formal ceremony and reception, featuring games and entertainment.
